purpose: Define an UNKNOWN-safe Taiwan sector/market Above-MA participation measure that can distinguish broad participation from leader-dominated price strength without inheriting folklore thresholds.

externalEvidence.source: StockCharts ChartSchool Percent Above Moving Average
externalEvidence.use: Method definition and documented whipsaw risk; not evidence for Taiwan thresholds.

externalEvidence.source: Yu, Webb & Lin, Journal of Investing 2025
externalEvidence.use: Peer-reviewed evidence that index-over-moving-average percentages at multiple horizons are an empirical research family; does not authorize fixed Taiwan cutoffs.

currentSystemFacts: Existing research patch chain already computes market-level aboveMa20Pct and aboveMa60Pct from history-backed featureRows.
Existing buildTodaySectorStats(rows, features) already has same-day industry rows plus symbol feature mapping, so sector-level computation needs no new external source in principle.
Current Formal sector breadth is one-day advance share and is semantically different from multi-day Above-MA trend participation.
Post-V8.12/V8.14 live evidence is still constrained by history admission/recovery runtime issues, so L3 is not claimed.

frozenDefinitions.memberPass: close_t > MA_h_t using only bars whose session/completion/source admission is PIT-valid
frozenDefinitions.sectorNumerator: count of PIT-valid sector members passing memberPass
frozenDefinitions.historyReadyDenominator: count of sector members with PIT-valid complete history and finite MA_h
frozenDefinitions.membershipDenominator: count of PIT-valid sector members in the classification vintage at decision time
frozenDefinitions.noKnownHistory: If historyReadyDenominator=0, Above-MA state is UNKNOWN, not 0%.
frozenDefinitions.classificationClock: classificationSchemeId + effectiveFrom/effectiveTo + knownAt; current labels may not be backfilled historically.

denominatorGuards: Do not compare point estimates across sectors without coveragePct and membership count.
Do not silently drop missing-history members and call the resulting ratio full-sector breadth.
Do not mix Formal-normalized universe breadth with official whole-market breadth.
For small sectors, report member count and candidate leave-one-out sensitivity; one stock may materially flip the ratio.
Suspensions/no-trade sessions remain valid only under the shared history/source admission contract.
positiveMechanism: A rising sector/index driven by many members holding above their own trend references represents broader trend participation than the same price return driven by a few leaders.
Above-MA participation can be slower but more persistent than one-day advance/decline breadth, potentially separating trend diffusion from a single-day rebound.
20-day and 60-day horizons can describe short/intermediate participation without assuming either is superior.
falsification: If Above-MA adds no incremental information after sector return/RS, one-day advance breadth, equal/median return, leader concentration/HHI, dispersion and market regime, classify it REDUNDANT.
If predictive direction flips across trend/range or high/low-volatility regimes, no permanent positive sign is allowed.
If results disappear after leave-one-out candidate removal in small sectors, treat them as self-inclusion artifacts.
If low history coverage explains high/low readings, treat the breadth state as DATA_QUALITY_BLOCKED rather than bullish/bearish.
If only one MA horizon/threshold looks good after a parameter sweep, reject for data snooping.
Whipsaw around moving-average crossings is expected; breadth crossing a round-number threshold is not by itself a trading signal.
redundancyControls: leader top1/top3 amount share and HHI
preregisteredOutcomeFamily: D1/D3/D5 sector and candidate residual return

promotionGate.L2: Mechanism, denominator semantics, counterexamples and redundancy controls frozen.
promotionGate.L3: At least one clean post-repair Taiwan PIT receipt with exact membership/history coverage and replayable 20/60-day values.
promotionGate.L4: Prospective/OOS independent-date evidence with controls and no threshold sweep.
promotionGate.L5: Multi-regime incremental value, costs/coverage, redundancy and independent-date robustness.

exactNext: BR-034 implement an isolated research-only Above-MA receipt builder against existing featureRows/industry membership, with coverage bounds and leave-one-out outputs.
Do not wire Formal thresholds or System2 weights.
When the first clean post-repair scan exists, freeze one outcome-blind live receipt before any return join.
